Source contracts: scripts/documentation_repair_ledger.py

scripts/documentation_repair_ledger.py

Python · Tier B

Collect auditable documentation debt without inferring semantic review completion.

Usage

Supply --reports with fresh source, diagnostic and content-quality JSON reports.

Inputs

--root selects source ownership; --output names the ledger; --previous retains history.

Side effects

Write one requested JSON ledger; inspected application modules never execute.

Cleanup

No service, database, environment or external process is created.

@see scripts/source_documentation_audit.py

@see scripts/error_catalog_audit.py

@see scripts/error_catalog_quality.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
read_json 23 Require each audit input to exist rather than treating a missing report as zero debt.
findings 28 Bind structural findings to source identities; review evidence stays explicitly empty. Stable identities omit line numbers, which move when comments are repaired. Source hashes detect subsequent edits but never stand in for review evidence.
reconcile 141 Retain absent findings without fabricating closure or duplicating legacy identities. Early ledgers omitted the occurrence suffix from their digest. Match their explicit source identity as occurrence zero, retaining separate later occurrences of the same symbol. Presence in a fresh report always reopens it.
main 170 Write an explicit open-debt census and preserve previous source identities on refresh.
